URL: https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-may-17-2026/
TITLE: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, May 17, 2026
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-17 23:29 UTC
AUTHOR: Stefaniia Bern (ISW)

KEY TAKEAWAYS:
1. Ukrainian forces struck several Russian defense industrial plants and oil infrastructure in Moscow City and Oblast overnight 16-17 May, following Russia's intensified strikes on Ukraine 13-14 May
2. Ukraine's strikes proved Russia "continues to be unable to effectively defend the Russian capital" — generated frustration in ultranationalist info space
3. Russian forces recently advanced in Hulyaipole direction
4. Ukrainian forces continued long-range strike campaign against Russian warships in Caspian Sea
5. Russian forces launched 278 drones against Ukraine

UKRAINIAN STRIKES ON MOSCOW (CONFIRMED OBJECTS):
- Angstrem Semiconductor Plant, Elma Technopark, Zelenograd (NW of Moscow City) — produces microelectronics for high-precision weapons; smoke plume geolocated
- Solnechnogorsk oil pumping station near Durykino (NW of Moscow City) — pumps/stores/ships large volumes of fuel for Russian forces; large fire geolocated
- Moscow Oil Refinery, Kapotnya Raion, Moscow City — SBU; smoke plume + audible explosion geolocated; Sobyanin claimed only "checkpoint" hit
- Volodarsk oil pumping station (SE of Moscow City)
- Sheremetyevo International Airport runway fire — drone wreckage hit runway; Russian Transportation Ministry: 51 flights diverted; 2/3 flights delayed 2+ hours
- Sobyanin claimed Russian forces downed 120+ drones over Moscow City on 16-17 May
- Ukrainian drones used: RS-1, FP-1, BARS-SM

UKRAINIAN STRIKE ON CASPIAN SEA:
- Project 10410 Svetlyak-class patrol ship belonging to Russian FSB Border Service in Kaspiysk, Republic of Dagestan (~1,000km from frontline)

KREMLIN RESPONSE — MUTED:
- Zakharova (MFA): criticised Ukrainian strikes for "impact against civilians", omitted defence industrial plants/oil infrastructure
- Peskov (Kremlin spokesperson): Russia "cannot be threatened as a nuclear power and its very existence cannot be threatened"
- Russian state TV (Perviy Kanal, Rossiya-1, NTV) gave only ~1 minute coverage; only briefly focused on civilian implications
- Russian milbloggers furious: ineffective air defences, called for multi-echeloned unified air defence network around Moscow
- Some milbloggers called for retaliation with tactical nuclear weapons

UKRAINIAN STRIKE — CRIMEA BELBEK MILITARY AIRFIELD (Sevastopol, ~325km from frontline):
- Pantsir-S2 air defense system
- Hangar housing S-400 radar
- Orion drone control system
- Forpost ground-based UAV control system
- Ground-to-air data transmission system
- Control tower and hangar
- Sevastopol occupation governor Razvozhaev acknowledged strikes

RUSSIAN AIR CAMPAIGN OVERNIGHT 16-17 MAY:
- 287 Shahed, Gerbera, Italmas drones + Parodiya decoys
- 279 downed; 8 hit 7 locations
- Strikes on Dnipro, Kyiv, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv Oblast
- Russia may have resumed using Belarusian telecoms infrastructure to support strikes

ZELENSKY ON RUSSIAN STRIKES PAST WEEK:
- 3,170 long-range strike drones, 74 missiles, 1,300 guided glide bombs against Ukraine since ~May 10

GROUND OPERATIONS:
- Ukrainian forces liberated Odradne (east of Velykyi Burluk); 22 sq km seized in direction
- Ukrainian Joint Forces: Russian forces withdrawing in some areas of Velykyi Burluk
- Russian forces "intensifying ground operations and interdiction efforts in the Slovyansk direction"
- Spring-Summer 2026 offensive ongoing
- Russian 423rd Motorized Rifle Regiment congratulated for claimed seizure of Borova
